title: BiomeOres
description: biome based ore gen split ores into progression based exploration
body:
this is a janky system made for a server that i just want to share 
use something like a [viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei-worldgen) to see where they are

ores are mostly found higher up to make strip mines les worth and ballance exploration

iron is in common spawning biomes like forrest and plains
coal is where ever it wanted to be
diamonds are deep idk
redstone is in biome caves and stony peaks
gold is in hot biomes
zinc from [create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) is supported and found in hot biomes too
copper is found in cold biomes
emeralds are found in stony peaks
lapis is found on stony shores
